text:
Lina: Heads up — partners asked to confirm Dedicated GPU quota for eu-west-IE (Ireland) before next Monday. Need to sync capacity, Marketplace listing ETA, and press plan.

Raj: What's the quota ask? GPUs / vCPUs / baremetal nodes?

Lina: Primary ask: 50 v100-equivalent GPUs (can be mix: A100 or T4 fallback), plus 10 baremetal nodes for on-prem style customers. Target launch: 06/15.

Mia: For marketplace listing, we need SKU entitlements + legal sign-off on joint announcement. @Sarah-legal, can you advise timeline?

Sarah-legal: Can do quick review by Fri if we get the draft by Wed EOD. Need partner MSA excerpt and KMS flow doc.

Oliver: Ops Q — Raj, is that quota realistic in AWS eu-west-1? Also consider GCP ireland (europe-west1) for multi-cloud redundancy.

Raj: I'll run a capacity check with the cloud partner PMs. If we use a Dedicated pool we'll reserve via partner entitlement. I'll ping the partner contact and loop back by tomorrow.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: PARTNERS-4823 — Ireland capacity gating checklist. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PARTNERS-4823

Lina: Also need to coordinate kernel/driver matrix for A100 across our private runtime. @eng-runtime can we get a compatibility report? Mia will attach model perf baseline.

Mia: Adding perf baseline to the ticket: `s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/ie-launch/` — includes 99p latency targets and perf vs quantization.

Raj: Partner replied: "can guarantee 30 A100s initially, + burst to 50 with 7-day notice. Asking if we can support fallback to T4 for non-SLA customers."

Lina: OK — proposal: launch with 30 guaranteed + burst 50, offer two SKUs: Dedicated (SLA) and Marketplace standard (best-effort, T4 fallbacks). Drafting PRD now.

Sarah-legal: Agree. For press: need joint quote approvals. Partner requests 48h review window pre-announce.

Oliver: Can marketing hold off on any press until entitlements & quota are confirmed? @marketing-channel

Mia: I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with the partner next Tue 10am PT and post the calendar invite.

Lina: :thumbsup: Thanks all — tagging action owners in PARTNERS-4823. We'll reconvene after Raj's capacity check and Sarah's legal review.
